The short version

Models propose.
Deterministic code decides.

At Avinya Neurotech, I work on EEG recordings of brain activity: storing them, processing them and sending the part a viewer needs.

My own projects use local models to search documents, draft tasks and suggest video edits. Ordinary code decides what those suggestions can do.
